title: Manager dashboard
question: Now the manager dashboard for the direction and teachers (lessons & quizzes, students & notifications, emploi du temps). Every option also has a full timetable view. Pick one structure, steer it, or re-roll.

options.label: Student files first
options.lineage: the file the centre keeps for each student: PAP, follow-up, progress
options.thesis: The dashboard opens on the students: each file shows video, résumé and quiz progress, and every action starts from a child.
options.viewport: Sidebar (Élèves, Leçons, Emploi du temps, Notifications); a class roster with progress strips; the selected student's file on the right.
options.risk: Lesson authoring sits one level deeper, so publishing takes an extra click.

options.label: Lesson pipeline
options.lineage: the teachers' preparation board, from draft to published
options.thesis: Lessons move across a board from draft to published; each card shows whether its video, résumé and quiz are ready.
options.viewport: Columns Brouillon, À relire, Publiée, Programmée; opening a card slides in the editor with the student-app preview.
options.risk: Student follow-up becomes a separate view instead of the home.

options.label: Follow-up inbox
options.lineage: the morning list a coordinator works through
options.thesis: The home is a triage list of what needs attention today: students falling behind, lessons missing a quiz, timetable changes to announce.
options.viewport: Today's timetable strip on top; alert rows with actions below (relancer, compléter le quiz, prévenir la classe); a detail pane on the right.
options.risk: On a quiet day the home looks empty, so it needs a good calm state.
